title: sambucus pubens f. leucocarpa
intro: Sambucus pubens f. leucocarpa, commonly known as American White Elderberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including immune system support, anti-inflammatory and antiviral actions, and potential relief from cold and flu symptoms. The therapeutic actions of American White Elderberry include stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiviral properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and anthocyanins. The bioactive constituents present in American White Elderberry contribute to its medicinal effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential uses and applications.
